dependency_edges.handoff: Cleaned records and assumptions feed the RRBS rating interface.
Rating vector and product/month grouping feed the review-vector interface.
Monthly RRBS scores feed time-weighted reputation.
Reputation and review-count proxy feed trend evaluation.
Reputation series feed GPR successfulness prediction.
Review polarity and ordered ratings feed k-event analysis.
Graded words and score/reputation outputs feed wording association and strategy.
Forecast boundary and product labels enter monitoring advice.
High/low event evidence bounds the manager recommendations.
